read_notes: File is UTF-8 with a BOM and CRLF line endings; a naive pd.read_csv() leaves the BOM on the first header name ('\ufeffUnnamed: 0'), so encoding='utf-8-sig' is required. There are NO embedded newlines inside quoted fields and every record has exactly 26 fields, so csv.reader and pandas agree on the row count. dtype=str + keep_default_na=False + na_values=[''] is recommended so that Postcode_py keeps its leading zeros and '-NA'/'-NA-' sentinels stay visible instead of being silently cast.
row_count_explanation: wc -l reports 1984 because the file has 1984 newline-terminated physical lines: 1 header + 1983 data records, and it ends with a trailing CRLF. There are no embedded newlines (csv.reader returns 1984 records, all exactly 26 fields wide), so the true data shape is 1983 x 26, not 1984 x 26.

columns.name: Unnamed: 0
columns.notes: Preserved pandas RangeIndex from an upstream frame. Monotonic increasing 0..2090 with 108 missing integers -> the upstream frame had 2091 rows and 108 were dropped before export. Unique here but meaningless as an entity key.

columns.name: Hospital_Id
columns.notes: CGHS/HMIS application id. Unique across all 1983 rows. Structure: prefix HOSP (1901) or LAB (81) + state code digits + ownership letter (G/P/T, HOSP only) + application serial. One malformed value ('17006035', row 1050) has no prefix.

columns.name: Hospital_Name
examples: Malla reddy narayana multispeciality HospitalA unit of chandramma educational society
Satya Kidney Centre  And Super Speciality Hospital
columns.notes: Facility name as typed by the applicant. Mixed case (1424 UPPER, 51 lower, 508 mixed), 36 rows with double spaces, 117 contain 'unit of' / corporate-entity suffixes. No non-ASCII.

columns.name: District
columns.notes: Mostly UPPERCASE; 8 values in title case. 39 rows hold the sentinel '-NA-' (all ANDHRA PRADESH). 101 distinct values incl. sentinel. 'RANGA REDDY' appears under both TELANGANA (14) and ANDHRA PRADESH (1).

columns.name: State
columns.notes: 24 distinct, all UPPERCASE, no sentinel/nulls. Uses 'NCT OF DELHI'. Covers only 24 states/UTs - no Himachal, Assam, Chandigarh, NE states other than Meghalaya/Tripura.

columns.name: Hospital_Contact
columns.notes: Single phone number. 1941/1983 are valid 10-digit Indian mobiles (leading 6-9); 3 rows are literal '0', 1 row is '-NA-', 38 rows null. 201 rows share a number with another row (max reuse: 9810423972 x10) - chain / corporate-group hospitals.

columns.name: Specialities_Selected
columns.notes: Comma-delimited multi-value code list, trailing comma on every non-null value, leading comma on 383 rows. 47 distinct tokens across TWO mutually exclusive codebooks (see coded_vocabularies): a 22-code 2-letter family and a 24-code M#/S# family. No row mixes families. 280 rows repeat a token within the row.

columns.name: Hospital_Type
columns.notes: Ownership. 517 rows (26.07%) null; part of that is structural (80 of the 81 LAB-prefixed rows and all 3 'T'-letter rows are null). Disagrees with the Hospital_Id ownership letter on 8 rows (5 G-rows typed Private, 3 P-rows typed Public).

columns.name: Empanelment_Type
columns.notes: Which scheme(s) the facility is empanelled under. Binary.

columns.name: Submitted_Date
columns.notes: Constant literal '-NA' on all 1983 rows. Carries no information; the source column was blanked before export.

columns.name: Status_Updated_Date
columns.notes: Constant literal '-NA' on all 1983 rows. Carries no information.

columns.name: Application_Status
columns.notes: Constant 'Hospital Approved for Empanelment' on all 1983 rows. The file is a pre-filtered approved-only slice, so the column is informative about the dataset but not about any row.

columns.name: OnBoarded_For_Convergence_Scheme
columns.notes: Yes/No flag for the CGHS-PMJAY convergence onboarding. Note it does NOT agree with Empanelment_Type: 1015 'Yes' vs only 69 'PMJAY and CGHS'.

columns.name: Address
examples: VISAKHA INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES , VISHAKHAPATNAM, ANDHRA PRADESH
SANKAR FOUNDATION EYE HOSPITAL & INSTITUTE, VISHAKHAPATNAM, ANDHRA PRADESH
Malla reddy narayana multispeciality HospitalA unit of chandramma educational society, -NA-, ANDHRA PRADESH
Satya Kidney Centre  And Super Speciality Hospital, -NA-, ANDHRA PRADESH
columns.notes: NOT a street address. It is the literal concatenation Hospital_Name + ', ' + District + ', ' + State - byte-identical on 1875/1983 rows (94.55%) and identical on 1983/1983 rows (100%) once whitespace is collapsed (the 108 exceptions carry a stray space before the first comma). Zero incremental information over the three source columns.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.notes: Forward-geocoded from the synthetic Address string (not surveyed). 100% populated, no zeros, 1776 distinct pairs; 109 rows sit on one of 10 coordinates shared by >=5 rows, which are administrative centroids (e.g. 15.9128998/79.7399875 = Andhra Pradesh state centroid, 37 rows).

columns.name: Longitude
columns.notes: Same provenance as Latitude. Two rows carry US coordinates (negative longitude).

columns.name: Postcode_py
columns.notes: Extracted from address_py, not from the source registry - it is a substring of address_py in 1935/1935 non-null rows. 1934 are 6-digit; 1 is '3302' (row 220, a US ZIP 03302 with the leading zero eaten by a numeric cast). 48 rows null. The '_py' suffix marks it as a Python-pipeline output.

columns.name: address_py
examples: Chinna Gadhili, Visakhapatnam, Visakhapatnam (Urban), Visakhapatnam District, Andhra Pradesh, 530001, India
Sankar Foundation Eye Hospital, Vishakapatnam - Srungavarapukota - Araku Road, Vepagunta, Pendurthi, Visakhapatnam District, Andhra Pradesh, 530047, India

Malla Reddy Narayana Multispeciality Hospital, Jeedimetla Main Road, Colony Name, Gandimaisamma, Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation North Zone, Hyderabad, Quthbullapur mandal, Medchal–Malkajgiri District, Telangana, 500055, India
Vinukonda - Mupparajuvaripalem Road, Lakshmipuram, Nuzendla, Palnadu District, Andhra Pradesh, 522660, India

Sai Vani Super Specialty Hospital, Indira Park Road, Aravinda Nagar, Ward 90 Kavadiguda, Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation Central Zone, Hyderabad, Himayatnagar mandal, Hyderabad District, Telangana, 500029, India
columns.notes: Reverse-geocoded address string for (Latitude, Longitude), Nominatim/OSM formatted ('..., <District> District, <State>, <PIN>, India'). 1981/1983 end in 'India'. This is the only real street-level address text in the file, but it describes the geocode result, not the registry record.

columns.name: Levenshtein Distance
columns.notes: = 1 - OSA_edit_distance(Address, address_py)/max(len). Reproduced exactly on 1983/1983 rows. A SIMILARITY despite the name.

columns.name: Jaro Wrinkler Distance
columns.notes: = JaroWinkler.similarity(Address, address_py). Reproduced exactly on 1983/1983 rows. A SIMILARITY despite the name.

columns.name: Jaccard Distance
columns.notes: = bag-of-CHARACTERS Jaccard similarity of (Address, address_py): |multiset intersection| / (len(a)+len(b)-intersection). Exact on 1983/1983 rows. Character-multiset, not token - so it is dominated by casing and length, not by address content.

columns.name: Cosine Distance
columns.notes: = bag-of-CHARACTERS cosine similarity: intersection/sqrt(len(a)*len(b)). Exact on 1983/1983 rows.

columns.name: Monge Elkan Distance
columns.notes: Range 0.00218-0.01341, far below the [0,1] range a real Monge-Elkan similarity occupies. Not reproduced by any standard Monge-Elkan variant tried (best: comma-token Jaro ME divided by len(Address), r=0.81, no exact rows). Correlates -0.63 with len(Address) - looks like a length-divided / buggy implementation. UNRESOLVED.

columns.name: BWTRLENCD Distance
columns.notes: = 1 - NCD(Address, address_py) where the compressor is Burrows-Wheeler transform followed by run-length encoding: (C(a)+C(b)-C(ab))/max(C(a),C(b)). Reproduced exactly on 1931/1983 rows (97.4%), r=0.9985; residual rows presumably differ in BWT sentinel/tie-break. Takes negative values on 1129 rows and is exactly 0 on 259 rows.

columns.name: Monge Elkan Distance*10
columns.notes: Exactly 10 x 'Monge Elkan Distance' (max abs deviation 5e-9). Fully redundant.

columns.name: Auto Score
columns.notes: Exactly affine in three of the other columns: 0.1867386636*Levenshtein + 0.1975256764*JaroWinkler + 0.6157356594*MongeElkan*10 + 0.4287057853 (R^2=1.0, max residual 9.0e-10; the three weights sum to 1.000000). Jaccard, Cosine and BWTRLENCD contribute nothing. No documented threshold; range is narrow [0.5351, 0.7189].

duplicates.method: exact = df.duplicated() over all 26 columns (also 0 after dropping 'Unnamed: 0'). near_dupe_name_geo = df.duplicated(subset=[normalized_name, lat/lon rounded to 3dp]) where normalized_name = uppercase, non-alphanumerics -> space, drop tokens {PVT,PRIVATE,LTD,LIMITED,THE,AND,A,UNIT,OF}, collapse whitespace. 3dp ~ 110 m.
duplicates.notes: 32 rows fall into 15 groups that are identical on (name, district, state, address, lat, lon) but carry different Hospital_Id and different Specialities_Selected - i.e. the same physical facility filed multiple empanelment applications, one per specialty batch or per codebook version. Example: 'Aditya Super Speciality Hospital & Trauma Centre', JABALPUR - HOSP23P120251 (M5,S10,S11,S3) and HOSP23P128502 (21 two-letter codes).

geo_quality.geocode_provenance: Coordinates are forward-geocoded from the synthetic Address string ('Name, District, State'). Where the geocoder could not resolve the name it fell back to a district or state centroid, so 111 rows share 17 centroid coordinates. The two out-of-bbox rows resolved to the United States (row 220 -> Concord, New Hampshire; row 1319 -> Bedford County, Tennessee).

candidate_primary_key.notes: Unique and complete, and it is a real upstream application id (not a row number), so it is the correct source_facility_id. It is an APPLICATION id, not a facility id: 15 groups of rows are the same facility under different Hospital_Ids. 'Unnamed: 0' is also unique but is a discarded pandas index and must not be used.

coded_vocabulary_notes.Specialities_Selected: 47 distinct tokens in two MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE families - 968 rows use only the 22 two-letter codes, 745 rows use only the 24 M#/S# codes, 33 rows use two-letter codes plus a literal 'NA'; zero rows mix the families. Neither codebook's expansion is present in this file. The split is not random: 204 of the 303 Delhi rows that carry specialties use the numeric family while 299 of the 316 such UP rows use the two-letter family, two-letter family, so it most likely reflects two different CGHS application-form vintages.
coded_vocabulary_notes.Hospital_Id__state_code: Matches LGD/Census-2011 state codes on 24 of the 26 observed values (3=Punjab, 7=Delhi, 9=UP, 19=West Bengal, 27=Maharashtra, 36=Telangana, ...). Two disagree: code 4 (LGD=Chandigarh) is carried by 17 rows whose District is Amritsar/Jalandhar/S.A.S Nagar and State is PUNJAB, and code 37 (LGD=Ladakh) is carried by 1 Delhi row. Likely a CGHS administrative-city code that coincides with LGD for most states.
coded_vocabulary_notes.Hospital_Id__ownership_letter: G correlates with Hospital_Type='Public' (29/35 non-null), P with Private (1426/1429 non-null), T appears on 3 Gujarat trust-run hospitals whose Hospital_Type is null. Reading G=Government, P=Private, T=Trust is consistent with the data but is not documented anywhere in the file.

provenance.reason: Both date columns (Submitted_Date, Status_Updated_Date) are the constant literal '-NA' on all 1983 rows, so no per-row or dataset-level date can be derived from the data. The only date signal is the filename token '18_SEPTEMBER_23' -> 2023-09-18, which should be treated as an externally-asserted snapshot date, not a measured one.

er_readiness.blocking_key_notes: (state, district, normalized_name) is viable for 1944/1983 rows (98.03%). The 39 rows with District='-NA-' are all ANDHRA PRADESH and 37 of them also sit on the AP state centroid, so they must fall back to (state, name) blocking. (lat, lon) alone is NOT a safe blocking key: 111 rows sit on 10 administrative centroids. Pincode from Postcode_py is derived from the geocode, so it inherits the same error and must not be treated as an independent match signal.
er_readiness.unmatchable_rows_definition: rows lacking any of: non-empty name, a District other than '-NA-', in-bbox coordinates

dataset_summary.program: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) hospital/diagnostic-lab empanelment registry
dataset_summary.entity_grain: one empanelment APPLICATION (Hospital_Id), not one facility
